name: stash-work-plan
description: Resolve Git workspaces and resume shared component-oriented work through Stash.

interface.shortDescription: Resolve and resume agent work in Stash.
interface.longDescription: Resolve the current Git worktree to its Stash project, resume a shared plan, claim work atomically, checkpoint observed results, verify completion evidence, and hand off unfinished tasks.
defaultPrompt: Resume this project's next available Stash work item and continue from its checkpoint.
Resume a Stash work item by ID, verify its evidence, and finish or hand it off.
